doc.title: Dorothy Donegan — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Birthday wishes: health, travel and hearing great pianists
summary: She wants to get well, travel the world, live briefly in Switzerland, hear Peterson, Martha Argerich and Vegas shows.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: What other wish would you like, since this is your birthday?
To get well and sit down. Just travel.
Would you like to live any other special place?
I could live in Switzerland a little while.
Have a chalet in Switzerland? Who would you like to listen to while you’re travelling? Is there any musician that you would especially like to drop in on?
I’d go hear Peterson, Martha Argerich, some of those Russian pianists play. I like to be real sharp, though. And then I like to go to Vegas.
Who would you like to listen to in Vegas?
I’d like to see the shows.
